Résumé de recherche et limites

The captured PDF is an official English translation with the Arabic text alongside it. Article 1 provides for commencement six months after publication in the Official Gazette; the publication date and resulting commencement date were not established from this copy. This is a prototype record, not an authoritative statement of Jordanian law.

État de la règle: Non mis en œuvre (squelette vide)
